description: This Java class 'LoanAccountData' models detailed data related to loan accounts within the Fineract financial platform. It includes fields for loan identifiers, status, client and product details, terms, settings, timelines, associations, and various configurations. The class provides static factory methods for creating instances with specific data, methods for associating related data, and utility functions for handling borrower cycle variations and conversions. It also defines comparators and internal logic for managing loan data.

classes.name: LoanAccountData
classes.description: A data model representing detailed information about a loan account, including identifiers, status, client and product details, terms, settings, timelines, associations, and configurations. Contains methods for creating, updating, and associating related data, as well as utility functions for borrower cycle variations and conversions.
